summary: A cardholder makes purchases during a billing cycle, stays below the credit limit, receives a statement, and pays the full statement balance before the due date. The scenario exercises timely full repayment with the purchase grace period preserved and no late or over-limit fee triggered.
assumptions: The account has no previous balance at the start of this billing cycle, so new purchases qualify for the purchase grace period under clause.6.grace_period.
The statement closing date is 2025-05-31 and the payment due date shown on that statement is 2025-06-25, providing at least 25 days after statement close.
The credit limit is $1000.00, and the total outstanding balance never exceeds that limit at any time in the scenario.
The statement new balance is $250.00, so the contractual minimum payment would be max(3% of $250.00, $15.00) = $15.00; paying $250.00 satisfies clause.5.minimum_payment_obligation.
No cash advances, returned payments, foreign transactions, disputed charges, or expedited payment processing occur in this scenario.

A statement_close event is included to represent issuance of the periodic statement, but it does not itself perform a modeled obligation because no statement-delivery clause id is provided in the allowed binding list.
A due_check event is included to evaluate whether the due-date payment obligation was satisfied on time; it references clause.5.minimum_payment_obligation as the obligation being checked.
